verdict.rationale: v0 pushes generated code to a GitHub repository (v0-docs-2, v0-docs-31, v0-docs-39), which gives developers the raw code needed to deploy elsewhere, but v0's own deployment feature is explicitly tied to Vercel's infrastructure (v0-docs-8, v0-docs-32) with no documented workflow or guide for deploying to a non-Vercel host or self-managed infra. Missing for 10: explicit instructions/support for deploying to external hosts (AWS, Netlify, self-hosted servers), and any community evidence of someone actually deploying v0-generated code outside Vercel.
